assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease.
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
The service is consistent with the documented indication.
The service directly supports the medically necessary evaluation described in the clinical note.
The clinical note references the diagnoses I48.0 and I25.10.
